node: Data-center power distribution and electrical balance-of-system: switchgear, transformers, busbars, breakers, UPS subcomponents, power modules, and grid interconnect services
summary: Layer 1B expansion finds that the strongest underfollowed public-market mappings for this node are not generic data-center landlords but electrical equipment makers and project-execution contractors. Powell Industries and IES Holdings are the cleanest small/mid-cap discovery candidates because company disclosures explicitly reference data-center demand, backlog, or project execution. nVent is larger and more visible but has unusually direct exposure after acquiring Avail's enclosures, switchgear, and bus systems assets. Atkore is a lower-attention second-order electrical-products candidate with direct end-market language but weaker proof of AI/hyperscaler backlog. Reference leaders such as Eaton, Vertiv, Hubbell, Quanta, and EMCOR remain context anchors but are intentionally not prioritized in this underfollowed pass.
